system.description:
Why do birds suddenly appear, every time you are near? —Karen Carpenter, Close to You Keepers of the wilderness, druids are mystics of nature that are adopted into beast-kind.

The druid is a mid-defense, mixed support and control class with a focus on Casting Spells and shapechanging to powerful beasts.

  • Action: Cast or Beast Attacks
  • Move: Midline
  • Key Stat: Awareness
  • Complexity: HHHII
  • Training: Mysticism, Survival

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Primal Mystic
features.description:
You can Cast Spells using Survival.

Spells: You learn 2 Spells, one of which must always be Polymorph. You learn 1 other Spell every 3 Levels hereafter.

Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (2 × your Level), and your Cast Max for Spells is equal to (1 + half your Level, round up).

features.name: Feral Shift
features.description: You get the Shapechanger Perk (p. 72) and, when you Cast Polymorph on yourself, you can also take an Action of the Beast.

features.name: Savagery
features.description:
The damage you deal with the attacks of Beasts and your effective Level for the purposes of the Polymorph Spell are both increased by 1 now and every 4 Levels hereafter.

Druid: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Tempest Within
features.description:
You reduce Cold, Fire, and Shock damage you take by 1 per damage die. This reduction is increased by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Druid: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Beast Mode
features.description:
The attacks you make as Beasts ignore Immune to non-Relic damage.

Further, when you are the sole Target of a casting of your Polymorph Spell, you can make the duration continual (p. 10).

features.name: Force of Nature
features.description: Once per Shift, if you are reduced to 0 HP, you can polymorph into a Beast and regain HP equal to that shown in its Statblock.
